name: Time2Play Live
subtitle: Card and dice games, together
promotionalText: Start a private room, share the code, and play. Bots fill empty seats, and you can practice against them with no signal.
description:
Time2Play is a small set of card and dice games you play together, each person on their own phone.

Start a room, share the code or the link, and everyone's in. You don't need an account to play.

THE GAMES
• Overdraft: match the suit or the number, and be first to empty your hand. 3 to 10 players.
• Hot Dice: roll six dice, keep what scores, and know when to bank. 2 to 8 players.
• Roll Call: five dice, three rolls, thirteen boxes to fill. Solo, or up to 8.
• Close Enough: give a range that holds the answer. Tighter scores more. Solo, or up to 8.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Private rooms: only people with the code or link can join.
• Bots fill empty seats, and a bot holds your seat if your phone drops.
• No signal? Practice against bots right on your phone.
• Put the table on a TV with AirPlay so the whole room can watch.
• Friends without the app can join from a browser at time2play.live.

FRIENDS (OPTIONAL)
Sign in with Apple to add people you've played with, make groups, and send a challenge that drops everyone into a room. Accounts are for ages 13 and up.

KEPT SIMPLE
• No chat. Players send one of four set reactions.
• No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.
• Block or report any name from the player list.
• Delete your account anytime: You, then Delete account.

Questions or problems: hello@tyleralocke.com

review.notes:
Time2Play Live works without an account. Three quick ways to try it:

1. Offline, no network needed: on the Play tab, scroll to "No signal? Practice with bots" and tap Overdraft. Type any name and tap Join. Tap Easy and Normal to add two bots, then tap Start.
2. An online room with bots: on the Play tab, under "Start a room", tap Hot Dice. Type a name, add a bot, then tap Start.
3. Joining: a second device can join with the room code shown in the lobby, in the app or in a browser at time2play.live.

Signing in is optional (it adds friends, groups and challenges). The app only offers Sign in with Apple. Because you can't sign in with our Apple ID, there's a review sign-in:
1. Open the You tab.
2. Tap the version line at the bottom five times.
3. Enter the review key below and tap "Sign in for review".
Review key: {REVIEW_KEY}

You're then signed in as "Reviewer". You can open Friends, and delete the account under You, then Delete account (it signs you out and deletes everything for that account). Before Sign in with Apple, the app asks for a birth year; pick a year at least 13 years ago (under 13 stays a guest and can still play).

Other notes:
- Overdraft is a card game with no bets, stakes, chips or money of any kind.
- The camera is used only to scan a room's QR code to join it.
- Alerts are only for invites and challenges from friends.
- There's no chat; players can send only four set reactions. Display names go through a name filter, and any name can be reported or blocked from the player list.
